name: provenance-gate
description: CI gate that enforces a policy on npm provenance attestations: fails a build when a dependency's SLSA build source repo isn't on your allowlist. npm ships provenance data; nothing in the default install flow reads it.
author: __AUTHOR__

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist
